subtasks: Place the four eggs from the basket into the egg holder, then close the lid.
Gently seat the raised front edge of the egg holder lid so it closes fully over the four eggs, then return both arms home with open grippers.
Lift the front lip of the egg holder lid to reopen it and expose the four eggs so the high egg can be reseated.
Reseat the high rear-left egg in the bottom of its own cup. Keep the lid open and the other three eggs in their cups.
Withdraw the right hand from the egg holder. Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses, with the lid open and the eggs undisturbed.
